status: DRAFT for review; not registered, not frozen; the comparison is not authorised. Becomes m7o_decision_rule_v1 only when a campaign manifest pins it before launch.
experiment: three fresh v3 + btt_reward_v2 + btt_explore_cells_v1 runs (m7o_s{0,1,2}_x1, 3,072,000 transitions each) against the M7n v3 runs m7n_s{0,1,2}_v3 as the matched control, paired by seed
control_reuse_condition: runs/m7o/_control/control_check.json PASS on the manifest's code fingerprint and executable (R1: fresh 102,400-transition M7n-profile runs equal the M7n runs' ckpt_000102400 digests and rows in every seed); a failed check stops the campaign; fresh control training is a separate decision
matched: the M7n evaluation protocol (11 labels, 985 episodes per run)
only_difference: the [exploration] table: btt_explore_cells_v1 added to the learner reward during training; evaluation is identical (raw btt_reward_v2, no credit)

inputs_per_seed.K[a][s]: verified clears over the 200 final episodes (100 stochastic + 100 deterministic)
inputs_per_seed.X[a][s]: 1 iff a replay-verified qualified crossing or left-target break among the 100 final stochastic episodes (btt_qualified_crossing_v1)
inputs_per_seed.T[a][s]: mean targets of the 100 final stochastic episodes that are not verified clears (null when none)
inputs_per_seed.D[s]: T[exp][s] - T[ctl][s] (null when either is null)
inputs_per_seed.G[s]: T of the experimental final minus T of its own initial label (null when either is null)
inputs_per_seed.B[s]: the experimental run's exploration credit per episode over the run (reported; never gating)

gates_in_order.name: integrity
gates_in_order.condition: control check missing / failed / unbound; a run not verified; an evaluation label failing verification; a native clear not reproduced; an inexact gate-2 candidate; manifest drift; a control label changed

gates_in_order.name: incomplete
gates_in_order.condition: fewer than three verified experimental runs; a short final or initial label; a missing crossing verification

gates_in_order.name: first_clear
gates_in_order.condition: (sum K[exp] >= 1 and sum K[ctl] == 0) or K[exp][s] > K[ctl][s] in every seed

gates_in_order.name: control_clear_guard
gates_in_order.condition: sum K[ctl] >= 1 and sum K[exp] == 0: gates 2 and 4 cannot select the experimental arm (K[ctl] is 0 today; kept for symmetry)

gates_in_order.name: ceiling_broken
gates_in_order.condition: no guard; X[exp][s] == 1 in >= 2 seeds and X[ctl][s] == 0 in every seed

gates_in_order.name: exploitation
gates_in_order.condition: D defined and D[s] <= -1/2 in >= 2 seeds

gates_in_order.name: better_targets
gates_in_order.condition: no guard; D defined in every seed and D[s] >= +1/2 in every seed

gates_in_order.name: no_learning
gates_in_order.condition: >= 2 seeds with G defined and G[s] <= 0

precedence: gate 0, then incompleteness, then gates 1-6 in order; the first applicable gate decides; an inapplicable gate (null inputs) never decides; comparisons inclusive on exact integers / Fractions
reported_never_gating: credit per episode over the run per slot (must decay; a non-decaying credit is a defect report, not an outcome)
cells discovered per slot and pooled
early-sweep retention: R and seven-right counts
unqualified left entries with their replay analysis

budget.control: reused M7n v3 runs after R1
budget.runtime_estimate: about 3 x (50 min training + 45 min evaluation) + census and analysis, about 5 h
